 ‘Shrinking’ Season 4 Release Date Info, Cast, And More 
 Emmy Nominee Jason Segel Says ‘Shrinking’ Season 4 Feels Like A Return To His Rom-Com Roots 
 Stream It Or Skip It: ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4 On Apple TV, Where The Ever-Positive Coach Returns To Richmond To Lead Its New Women’s Soccer Team 
 I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again: Shrinking   is more than just a show about grief, forgiveness, and moving forward. It’s a celebration of romance, friendship, and found family. It’s an exhibition of empathy, community, accountability, and kindness that makes you want to become a better person. And in today’s world, that feels like essential viewing. So even though Season 3’s finale left fans and characters with a clear sense of closure, I was rooting for Shrinking Season 4.
 From the start of the series, co-creator Bill Lawrence said he envisioned a three-season arc that would explore three central themes. But just because the original vision is complete doesn’t mean the show has to end. “At the end of the third season, you can say, ‘Hey, are we having fun? Do you want to keep doing this?’ And the cool thing about streaming television is if you go on, it doesn’t mean you’re telling the same story and just beating a dead horse. You can come up with a whole other exciting journey in a different way,” Lawrence told Decider via Zoom, adding, “I’m having so much fun on this show.”
 So are Lawrence and co-creators Brett Goldstein and Jason Segel bringing Apple TV’s Emmy-nominated comedy back for more? Will there be a Shrinking Season 4? If so, when is Shrinking Season 4’s release date? What will Shrinking Season 4 be about? And who’s joining Shrinking ‘s Season 4 cast? Here’s everything to know about the future of Apple TV’s beloved series.
 Shrinking Season 3 Ending Explained : 
 If you’re looking for a detailed Shrinking Season 3 finale recap, Decider’s got you covered . As we said, when the end credits rolled on Season 3, there was a clear sense of closure within the show’s found family, but fans also didn’t want to say goodbye to these beloved characters yet. Thankfully, we didn’t have to!
 Will There Be Another Season Of Shrinking On Apple TV? Shrinking Season 4 Renewal Status:
 Great news,  Shrinking  stans! On Tuesday, January 27, hours before   Season 3’s supersized premiere started streaming,  Apple TV announced a rare, incredibly early Season 4 renewal ! So even though Paul and Alice are on the East Coast, we haven’t seen the last of the  Shrinking  fam.
 See Also 
 ‘Shrinking’s Christa Miller Shares Why The Season 3 Finale’s Last Song Gives Her “Goosebumps”: “It Was Everything I Wanted” 
 Has Shrinking Season 4 Started Filming? 
 Yes! In fact, in an October 18 Instagram post, star Jessica Williams revealed that Shrinking Season 4 had wrapped production, writing, “And that’s a wrappy poo on season 4!!! So thankful for this amazing cast and crew🫶🏽 love you shrinking!!” So what does that update mean for Season 4’s premiere?
 Shrinking  Season 4 Release Date  Info: When Does Season 4 Of Shrinking Come Out On Apple TV?
 Since  Shrinking  Season 4 filming just ended, there’s no official  Shrinking  Season 4 premiere date on the books right now. But Season 1 premiered in January 2023, Season 2 premiered in October 2024, and Season 3 premiered in January 2026. So there’s a chance we could see new episodes in the first half of 2027, depending on how long post-production takes. Stay tuned for updates, and keep reading for more info!
 How Many Episodes Are In Shrinking Season 4? 
 In an interview with  Variety , Ford revealed that  Shrinking  Season 4 would have 12 episodes, a return to Season 2’s count. Hooray!
 What Will Shrinking Season 4 Be About? 
 Since Shrinking Season 4 was announced, Lawrence and team have been incredibly transparent about a forthcoming time jump, and in early teases on X,  he wrote , “Excited to start completely new story next year. Feels scary/risky/fun.” Lawrence also  added , “We always pitched a three season story on #Shrinking, grief-forgiveness-moving forward. We wanted to stay true to that and end the way we planned.” The showrunner explained , “…If we came back Season 4 and Jimmy turned to Brian and said ‘I’ve been thinking about it, and I’m STILL really sad about my wife dying’ we’d stop watching along w everyone else. Time jump. New story. Same gang.”
 Photo: Apple TV 
 In an interview with LATimes shortly after Season 3, Segel also spoke on playing Jimmy in Season 4, saying, “I think an equally interesting and complicated and fun area is someone deciding they’re ready to be happy. Because God knows it’s one thing in your house alone in front of the mirror [to say], ‘Now I’m gonna be happy.’ And then you go out and in practice, it’s its own set of complications, right? And so, I’m actually really excited about that idea of someone saying, ‘OK, I’m ready to take it for a spin.’ And then seeing that’s its own thing.”
 At Paleyfest 2026 , Lawrence also teased, “I think people will feel when they come back to this show, that it’s a completely different story. And the reason we agreed to do it was that we feel that the cast and characters of this show have enough stuff going on in their life that we are interested in seeing what a new story for these characters looks like.”
 See Also 
 Give Harrison Ford The Emmy For ‘Shrinking,’ You Cowards 
 Is Harrison Ford Leaving  Shrinking ? 
 No way! When Season 4 was announced, Lawrence and cast members were quick to assure fans  that Ford is in Season 4 — even if Paul’s in Connecticut. “He is not leaving the show,” Shrinking ‘s co-creator stressed . “He’s not going anywhere. Not an accident that Alice goes to college in Connecticut.”
 When chatting with Deadline , Lawrence also spoke of Paul and Julie (Wendie Malick), saying, “I’m fascinated, along with the writing staff, of what does that look like a couple of years from now? Did it work? Is it hard? Does he miss people? Is he doing better? Is he doing worse? And the one thing I can tell you, Harrison’s such an inspiring guy as a performer, to watch him play that character. We’re going to make sure that it reads the same way.”
 The fact that Alice is going to college at Wesleyan University in Connecticut provides tons of bi-coastal potential for the series, and as someone who (like Lawrence) is from CT, I can’t wait to see what Season 4 has in store! (Hopefully a Harrison Ford Emmy !)
 Shrinking Season 4 Cast Guide: Who’s Joining Shrinking Season 4’s Cast? 
 In addition to the return of Ford and lots more fan-favorite Shrinking stars, Season 4 will welcome a number of exciting new guests to the series. There will likely be more casting announcements as we near a premiere date, but in case you missed it, here’s who’s joining Shrinking when the series returns with new episodes:
 Karen Gillan ( Guardians of the Galaxy )
 Judith Light ( Transparent , Ugly Betty )
 Christian Slater ( Mr. Robot )
 Scott Foley ( Felicity , Scrubs )
 Though specific details on characters are still under wraps, a recent  Deadline report revealed that “will play a therapy patient, sources close to production say.” Again, stay tuned for more updates!
 How To Watch Shrinking : Apple TV Streaming Info 
 Want to catch up on or rewatch Shrinking while you wait for Season 4? Since Shrinking is an Apple TV original series, you’ll have to subscribe to the platform to watch new and existing episodes.
 Apple TV comes with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers and has just one ad-free streaming plan available for $14.99/month.
 GET APPLE TV ONE WEEK FREE TRIAL 
 A bundle with Apple TV and Peacock is also available starting at $14.99/month.
 While we wait for more Shrinking Season 4 news, be sure to catch up on Decider’s Shrinking coverage for in-depth recaps, analysis, interviews with the cast, and more helpful show insights.
 Shrinking Season 3 is now streaming on Apple TV.
